Control agent sessions across computers from mobile
A commenter used Claude to build a mobile app, plus a Mac app for handoff, to control agent sessions across multiple computers.
·
Nov 19, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
The source only gives a brief commenter description: they made an app to control their agent sessions across multiple computers from a phone, then added a Mac app with the same sidebar so they could hand off from mobile to desktop quickly. It does not describe what access the agent had, the app’s internal workflow, or any human-in-the-loop steps.
How it went
The stated result was cross-device control of agent sessions plus faster handoff between mobile and Mac. The post gives no metrics, examples, or limitations.
Worth knowing
The thread links Hako.md, but this Reddit comment itself is too thin to copy from without opening the linked project page.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Help me build a small mobile-friendly web app, plus a simple desktop companion for [Mac or Windows], that lets me see and control my coding agent sessions running on [number] computers. It should list active sessions per machine, show their latest output, and let me send a new instruction from my phone. Start with a plan and an architecture I can run on my own network, then build the first working version that connects two machines.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1xzs6f1/show_us_what_youve_created_with_claude
